title: SAIA FedRAMP High announcement does not settle version, mode and runtime scope
problem: The audited High announcement and versioned deployment/runtime guides leave exact High version, mode, runtime and rollout boundaries unresolved.

audiences: Customers and documentation readers evaluating the stated decision
exclusions: No tenant rollout, entitlement, authorization or environment-specific approval is inferred.

impact.customerScenario: A reader evaluates the permitted SAIA app, mode and runtime in a regulated environment.
impact.consequence: An authorization announcement alone does not establish an available configuration for the intended stack.

confidence.rationale: Historical published observations are normalized without creating a new source review or numeric confidence score.

lifecycle.reason: No withdrawal, merge or supersession is recorded.

evidence.section: FedRAMP deployments; supported regions; version compatibility
evidence.statement: The cited audit reviews this source within SAIA 2.3.6; versioned IL2 and October 19 High announcement. IL2 excludes Agent Mode and fixes Splunk-hosted runtime; same-region prompt processing is conditional on Splunk-hosted choice. Exact High mode/version/runtime/rollout remains unresolved.
